title: Ovawatch Lab Manifest
description: Optional metadata for a bug-bounty reproduction lab. Place this file as `lab.json` in the lab's root folder. Every field is optional; the platform infers sensible defaults from package.json and README.md when fields are missing.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Defaults to the folder name.

title.description: Human-friendly lab name. Defaults to a prettified folder name.

summary.description: One-line blurb shown on the catalog card. Defaults to package.json description.

categories.description: Vulnerability classes / themes used for filtering, e.g. ["XSS", "Open Redirect"].

author.description: Lab author. Defaults to package.json author.

reportRef.description: Optional reference to the originating finding (id or URL, sanitized).

runtime.description: How the platform launches the lab. Inferred from package.json when omitted.

type.description: Runtime kind. Only "node" is supported today.

install.description: Install command run once when dependencies are missing. Defaults to "npm install".

portEnv.description: Env var the platform sets to the assigned port. Defaults to "PORT".

defaultPort.description: The port the lab listens on by default (documentation only; the platform assigns the real port).

readyPath.description: HTTP path polled to detect readiness. Defaults to "/".

cwd.description: Working subdirectory for the start command, relative to the lab root. Defaults to the lab root.

env.description: Extra non-secret environment variables passed to the lab.

brief.description: Markdown shown on the lab page. Defaults to the README body.

objectives.description: Checklist of what the learner should achieve.

hints.description: Progressive hints revealed one at a time.

solution.description: Markdown walkthrough, shown only behind a spoiler gate.
